$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006, FLR-ADR-007): FS_views 0.1.0, registry/FS_views/spec.md. Applied to the extension's top-level data, extensions.FS_views, by a validator that implements FS_views and knows it (spec.md 1.2). FS_views adds no kind of element and requires no other extension: its data is the house's saved views (views, records in the document's one space of IDs). What an ID names, an eye at its target, a day its month does not have and names that repeat are checked by the invariants (spec.md 2 and 3).
title: FS_views 0.1.0
description: Saved views of a house: named cameras - where each stands, what it looks at, its lens and picture, and what it shows: the levels, the sky, the date and time, and the lights - that every reader and agent can show.

views.description: 2.1: the saved views: an ID -> record map; the IDs share the document's one space of IDs.

length.description: Core 2.1: a length, an integer number of base units of 1/1280 mm.

point.description: 1.4: a point in space, [x, y, z]: plan coordinates (Core 2.3) and a height above project zero, each a length.

name.description: What it is called, 1-200 characters: "Hero exterior".

target.description: 2.2: the point it looks at (FS-VIEW-2.2.1: never its eye).

focalLength.description: 2.3: the lens's focal length in millimetres on a 36 x 24 mm frame, whose long side spans the picture's long side.

twoPoint.description: 2.3: two-point perspective: the camera held level and its lens shifted, so that vertical lines stay vertical.

aperture.description: 2.5: the f-number that sets the depth of field; absent, everything is in focus.

focus.description: 2.5: the distance in focus along the line of sight, a positive length; absent, the distance from the eye to the target. Only with an aperture.

exposure.description: 2.6: exposure compensation, in tenths of a stop.

level.description: 3.1: cut away above this level; absent, the whole house.

levels.description: 3.1: with level, that level and those below it ("cutaway"), or that level alone ("only").

sky.description: 3.2: the sky the house is seen under.

at.description: 3.2: the local date and time at the site that places the sun, ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, optional :SS, optional Z or an offset (FS-VIEW-3.2.1: a day its month has).

lights.description: 3.3: the house's light fixtures, off or every one on at full.

scene.description: 3.3: a scene of FS_lighting, whose lights the view shows as it sets them.

extras.description: As Core 1.7: data no specification defines.
